title: Large Language Models Pass the History Exam But Miss the <<History>>: A Polish High School Exit Exam Matura Benchmark
abstract: arXiv:2608.12343v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI chatbots are widely used by students as knowledge sources, yet LLM benchmarks rarely assess interpretative historical reasoning. We evaluate eight leading LLMs on the Polish high school exit exams (Matura) in history - three official papers from 2023-2025, comprising short-answer questions and extended essays - comparing model performance against the human examinee population. Every model dramatically outperforms human examinees, yet aggregate scores mask distinct competency profiles: rankings are unstable across task type, source modality, and geographical scope, with a consistent penalty on Polish versus Global history content. Qualitative error analysis reveals two recurring failure modes - source conflation, in which models reason from source content rather than treating it as an object of analysis, and temporal disorientation, in which responses are historically misplaced. This study introduces the first LLM history benchmark gro

translated_title: 大型语言模型通过历史考试却错过《历史》：波兰高中毕业考试Matura基准测试
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12343v1 公告类型：新 摘要：AI聊天机器人被学生广泛用作知识来源，然而LLM基准测试很少评估解释性历史推理能力。我们在波兰高中毕业考试（Matura）的历史科目中评估了八款领先的LLM——包括2023-2025年的三套官方试卷，涵盖简答题和扩展论文——并将模型表现与人类考生群体进行比较。每个模型都大幅优于人类考生，但综合分数掩盖了不同的能力特征：排名在任务类型、来源模态和地理范围上不稳定，且对波兰历史内容相比全球历史内容存在一致的扣分。定性错误分析揭示了两种反复出现的失败模式——来源混淆（模型基于来源内容推理，而非将其视为分析对象）和时空迷失（回答在历史上错位）。本研究引入了首个LLM历史基准测试组。
tldr: 本研究首次创建了基于波兰高中历史毕业考试的LLM基准测试，发现模型虽总体得分远超人类，但在历史推理上存在来源混淆和时空迷失的系统性缺陷，且对本国历史内容表现更差。
en_tdlr: This study introduces the first LLM history benchmark based on Polish Matura exams, revealing that while models outperform humans overall, they systematically suffer from source conflation and temporal disorientation in historical reasoning, with notably weaker performance on national history content.
